text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Wednesday:
-- Joblessness in Switzerland increased by 1.7 percent in the 1997 first quarter as compared to the comparable period of 1996, according to the Federal Statistics Office.
-- Swiss life insurance companies paid out 7.86 billion Swiss francs in claims during 1996, an increase of 9.5 percent as compared to the prior year.

-- The Swiss Bankers Association found pre-1945 dormant accounts containing 60 million Swiss francs. The association, in a worldwide campaign, is publishing a list of the more than 2,000 account holders' names.
